name: globalise-voc-transcriptions
description: Search and read ~4.8M machine-transcribed pages of Dutch East India Company (VOC) records, 17th-18th century.
long_description:
GLOBALISE serves machine transcriptions (HTR) of roughly 4.8 million pages of Dutch East India Company (VOC) records held at the Nationaal Archief in The Hague, spanning the 17th and 18th centuries and written mostly in early-modern Dutch.

This bundle runs the GLOBALISE MCP server **locally** inside Claude Desktop and exposes seven tools:

- **globalise_search_transcriptions** - full-text search across all ~4.8M transcribed pages, with composable inventory and language filters and language/inventory/document aggregations.
- **globalise_retrieve_document** - fetch a single page by document ID or URN: full line-by-line transcription, metadata, and previous/next page links.
- **globalise_navigate** - step to the previous or next page for sequential reading.
- **globalise_find_archival_documents** - query a bundled local index of 228K+ VOC finding-aid descriptions (offline; powered by SQLite FTS5) to scope a search before hitting the transcription API.
- **globalise_view_document_ui** - open an interactive side-by-side viewer (IIIF deep-zoom scan image + transcription) as an MCP App.
- **globalise_lookup_commodity** - look up VOC trade goods in a bundled commodities thesaurus (3,508 concepts) with bilingual NL/EN labels, period spelling variants, and sourced definitions.
- **globalise_lookup_measure** - look up VOC weights & measures in a bundled glossary (213 units) with period spelling variants, definitions, and period-reported conversion ratios.

The finding-aid index and reference glossaries ship inside the bundle and are queried entirely on-device; transcription search, page retrieval, and IIIF images are fetched from the public GLOBALISE/Nationaal Archief services at request time. No account, API key, or credentials are required.

debug_logging.title: Debug logging
debug_logging.description: Write per-tool diagnostic lines to the server's stderr log. Leave off for normal use.

structured_content.title: Send structured tool output
structured_content.description: Include machine-readable structuredContent alongside text results. Keep enabled for Claude Desktop; disable only for hosts that reject structured output.
